If you see \"Network connection lost\" after switching to the background, set up in this order:
1. Turn on \"Background keepalive\" above and keep its notification
2. Lock this app in the Recents screen instead of swiping it away
3. In system settings, set this app\'s battery policy to \"Unrestricted / Don\'t optimize\" and allow auto-launch
Huawei / Honor: App launch → Manage manually → Auto-launch, Associated launch, Run in background
Xiaomi / Redmi: Battery and performance → App battery saver → No restrictions
OPPO / OnePlus / realme: App management → Battery usage → Allow background activity; Battery → More settings → Optimize battery use → Don\'t optimize
vivo / iQOO: Battery → Background power consumption management → Allow high background power; Apps and permissions → Auto-start
Samsung: Battery and device care → Battery → Background usage limits → Never sleeping apps; Apps → Battery → Unrestricted

### Quick Start

1. **Official docs**: The full guide on SSH remote connection and file sync is in the AiVerse documentation (GitHub repo [yhdmgf/AiVerse](https://github.com/yhdmgf/AiVerse)).

2. **Top-right actions**: The **top-right** of this page has the entry points:
 - **Key icon**: click it to **save your SSH private key** (login key).
 - **+ icon**: click it to **add a host**.

3. **Add host**: enter the server **IP address** and **username**, select the saved key, and connect.

4. **After connecting**: **the AI can use the SSH terminal** for you and **upload files** to the server.
